meaning:
1) to feel, grope
1a) (Qal) to feel, grope
1b) (Piel) to feel over or through, grope
1b1) to feel through
1b2) to grope
1c)(Hiphil) to feel

elsewhere.note: What if my father touches me? I will seem to him as a deceiver, and I would bring a curse on myself, and not a blessing.”
Yahweh said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand toward the sky, that there may be darkness over the land of Egypt, even darkness which may be felt.”
You will grope at noonday, as the blind gropes in darkness, and you shall not prosper in your ways. You will only be oppressed and robbed always, and there…
They meet with darkness in the day time, and grope at noonday as in the night.
